ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Drawer 2 holds the Japan file. ... Drawer 9 holds the Finland file. ... Drawer 1 holds the Thailand file. ... Which drawer holds the file on the country whose capital is Bangkok?" -> answer org 1; the alt prompt asks about the Finland (bridge alt), its 2nd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 9 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 2 (answer at the same statement slot), 7 (the alt prompt's own answer), 1 (answer org kept).

example_lines.e5-digit: org prompt "... The Peru file is in drawer 2. ... The Pakistan file is in drawer 6. ... The Lebanon file is in drawer 8. ... What drawer keeps the file on the country whose capital is Beirut?" -> answer org 8; the alt prompt asks about the Peru (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 2 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 6 (answer at the same statement slot), 0 (the alt prompt's own answer), 8 (answer org kept).

Possible answers after the patch: yellow (answer of bridge alt's statement), blue (answer at the same statement slot), purple (the alt prompt's own answer), brown (answer org kept).
